Imat pisusa Gin Hanipyah orhe napanggeim yah nahatin dik oh gin hahmuro pot pisashenmur napor nohnong kis naham nadarhetirmur.

Wan aptei ihirdapatwi ihirnong winsi deipti ma hapat dahatinmat oh gur Iraija ohe ma patesuhnong dahatinmur. Oh patin oh tom mandap titapat patin krismas yitir birhima tit oh katket matipmur.
